versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2

- Documentation updated: SKILL.md has been revised.
- No functional or code changes; only documentation was modified.

Summary: Updated domain, now focuses on bridging CAD, mesh, and 3DGS representations and conversion.

- Renamed skill to "cad-mesh-3dgs" and updated description to reflect CAD/mesh/3DGS bridging and analysis of 35+ methods.
- Expanded scope beyond 3DGS paper reading to include mesh↔3DGS conversion, surface extraction, CAD reverse engineering, and B-rep/parametric reconstruction.
- Added detailed technical guides for mesh-to-3DGS and 3DGS-to-mesh pipelines, including initialization strategies, extraction methods, and troubleshooting tables.
- Introduced in-depth comparison tables, code snippets, and step-by-step pipelines for geometry processing and representation conversions.
- Updated trigger phrases to cover CAD modeling, parametric reconstruction, mesh/Gaussian hybrid terms, and related topics.

- Updated the method analysis to include 43+ methods (previously 40+).
- No other content or functionality was changed in this version.

Initial release: A comprehensive skill for bridging CAD, mesh, and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) representations.

- Supports mesh↔3DGS conversion and surface extraction from Gaussians, with detailed pipelines and troubleshooting tips.
- Guides reverse engineering workflows: CAD/B-rep/parametric reconstruction using 3DGS.
- Compares representation trade-offs (mesh, B-rep, 3DGS) for geometry, editing, rendering, and application domains.
- Analyzes and summarizes 40+ methods for geometry processing at the CAD–3DGS intersection.
- Provides comparison tables for mesh extraction from 3DGS, including recommended pipelines like SuGaR.
- Includes prompts and triggers for common tasks and research questions in this domain.
